name: Member
definition: A person recorded as a member of the student club, including ordinary members, officers, and inactive members.
scope: Club membership analysis; one row per person in tab08.

name: Member First Name
definition: Given/first name of a club member.
scope: Name construction and member-level listings.

name: Member Last Name
definition: Family/last name of a club member.
scope: Name construction, member listing, and last-name reporting.

name: Member Full Name
definition: Complete display name formed by joining the first name and last name with a single space.
scope: Questions asking for a member's full name or name.

name: Membership Position
definition: Role or status of a member within the club: ordinary Member, Inactive, President, Secretary, Treasurer, or Vice President.
scope: Distinguishing ordinary members from officers and inactive people.

name: T-shirt Size
definition: Recorded t-shirt size of a member: Small, Medium, Large, or X-Large.
scope: Member profile attribute used as a member filter.

name: Major
definition: An academic major/program offered by the university, with its administering department and college.
scope: Academic profile of members; one row per major in tab02.

name: Department
definition: Department, school, or program unit that administers a major (e.g., School of Applied Sciences, Technology and Education).
scope: Academic organization of majors and, through the member's major, of members.

name: College
definition: College that contains a department (e.g., College of Agriculture and Applied Sciences).
scope: Top-level academic organization of majors.

name: Event
definition: A student-club event with a name, date-time, type, location, notes, and status.
scope: One row per event in tab01.

name: Event Name
definition: Human-readable name of an event (e.g., April Speaker or Women's Soccer).
scope: Identifying or filtering events by name.

name: Event Date-Time
definition: Date and time at which an event occurs, stored as an ISO-8601 string including a time component.
scope: Event date filtering, ordering, and year extraction.

name: Event Type
definition: Category of an event: Meeting, Guest Speaker, Game, Social, Community Service, Election, Budget, or Registration.
scope: Classifying events; game questions refer to type Game.

name: Event Status
definition: Lifecycle status of an event: Open, Planning, or Closed.
scope: Filtering events by whether they are closed, open, or planned.

name: Event Location
definition: Free-text venue or location where an event is held (e.g., MU 215 or Campus Football stadium).
scope: Filtering or reporting events by venue.

name: Event Participation
definition: A recorded attendance/participation link between one member and one event.
scope: Attendance analysis; one row per member-event pair in tab04.

name: Budget Item
definition: A budget line for one event and one budget category, recording budgeted, spent, and remaining amounts.
scope: Event-level budgeting; one row per event-category pair in tab05.

name: Budget Category
definition: Expense category of a budget line: Food, Advertisement, Speaker Gifts, Parking, or Club T-Shirts.
scope: Grouping and filtering budget lines by category.

name: Budgeted Amount
definition: Amount of money budgeted for a budget item or category; equals spent plus remaining.
scope: Budget planning figures; distinct from actual expenses.

name: Spent Amount (Budget)
definition: Actual amount spent against a budget item; equals the sum of individual expenses linked to that budget item.
scope: Category- or event-level spending from the budget perspective.

name: Remaining Budget
definition: Unspent portion of a budget item; budgeted amount minus spent amount.
scope: Budget balance analysis.

name: Expense
definition: An individual expense transaction with description, date, amount, approval flag, and the member who incurred it.
scope: Item-level spending; one row per expense in tab06.

name: Expense Description
definition: Free-text description of goods or services purchased in an expense (e.g., Water, Veggie tray, supplies).
scope: Identifying or filtering individual expenses by what was bought.

name: Expense Date
definition: Calendar date on which an expense was incurred, stored as YYYY-MM-DD.
scope: Filtering expenses by date.

name: Expense Amount
definition: Monetary amount of an individual expense transaction.
scope: Item-level spending totals and cost calculations.

name: Event Cost
definition: Total cost of an event, obtained by aggregating the amounts of individual expenses whose budget item belongs to that event.
scope: Event-level cost reporting and cost-share calculations.

name: Income
definition: A record of funds received by the club from a member, with date, amount, source, and notes.
scope: Funds-received tracking; one row per income record in tab07.

name: Income Amount
definition: Monetary amount received in an income record (e.g., 50 for dues).
scope: Funds-received totals and per-member income analysis.

name: Income Date
definition: Calendar date on which funds were received, stored as YYYY-MM-DD.
scope: Filtering income records by date.

name: Income Source
definition: Category or source of an income record: Dues, Fundraising, School Appropration (as stored), or Sponsorship.
scope: Classifying funds received by source.

name: Income Notes
definition: Free-text note attached to an income record describing the purpose or circumstances of the funds received.
scope: Reading descriptive notes on income records.

name: Calendar Year
definition: Calendar year derived from a date value; for events, the first four characters of the ISO event date-time.
scope: Year-level grouping and comparison of events or financial records.

name: Percentage Share
definition: A part-to-whole ratio expressed as a percentage, where the part and whole are monetary amounts or counts.
scope: Share-of-total questions over costs, budgets, or member counts.
